description: Use when an AI cannot complete a task itself and needs a human or provider in Japan, or for a Japan-related real-world task. Examples include calling a public business, visiting a public place, inspecting or photographing something, packing/shipping/returning an item, pickup/drop-off, or another manual task. This only creates a manual-review request. It does not automatically hire, pay, purchase, or promise fulfillment.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this logical request. Reuse on retry after a lost response.

location.description: Location if relevant. Omit for remote or not-yet-specified tasks.

max_budget_jpy.description: Maximum budget the requester is willing to consider, in JPY. This is not a charge or authorization to spend.

objective.description: The outcome the agent needs from external execution.

name: request_external_execution
title: Request external execution in Japan
